PRODUCT OVERVIEW

ET is a geared electric dirt bike with a lightweight iron body, aluminium-alloy tail and swingarm, and a clutch-free four-speed system. Its official positioning emphasizes agile control for off-road terrain, obstacle riding, freestyle practice and short daily trips.

GEARED ELECTRIC DRIVEClutch-free four-speed system for familiar motorcycle-style control.
LIGHTWEIGHT MIXED-METAL FRAMEIron body with aluminium-alloy tail and swingarm.
OFF-ROAD DIMENSIONS350 mm ground clearance and 840 mm seat height.
